name: Dev Malik
summary: Engineer focused on helping support teams find dependable answers in large, frequently changing document collections. Four years working with manuals, scanned records, and internal help content.

work_experience.title: Document Intelligence Engineer
responsibilities_and_achievements: Built a handbook assistant that quotes the relevant source section beside each answer.
Kept headings and tables attached to their surrounding explanations when preparing lengthy manuals for search.
Compared literal phrase matching with numerical representations of meaning on questions written by support staff.
Traced incorrect answers to outdated pages, ambiguous product names, and missing source material; added checks for each case.
Updated changed pages without rebuilding the entire collection and removed withdrawn content from subsequent searches.

work_experience.title: Software Developer
responsibilities_and_achievements: Wrote import scripts and a Python service for organizing customer support attachments.
Added repeatable checks for malformed files and duplicate uploads.

projects.name: Maintenance manual finder
projects.description: Assembled a held-out set of technician requests and checked whether the first five returned passages contained the needed instruction. Reviewed failures separately for abbreviations and similar equipment names.
